explanation.value: Keep a pending buffer consisting of the held-back suffix plus the new chunk. Precompute the set of proper prefixes of all stop words. After appending a chunk, find the hold position: the smallest start among the last (longest - 1) positions whose suffix is a proper prefix of some stop word. Search pending for the earliest complete stop word. If one starts at or before the hold position, it is certain: release text before it and stop. Otherwise release pending up to the hold position and keep the rest. At the end, flush what remains, cut at any stop word.

explanation.value: Build the prefix set and the longest length. For each chunk: if stopped append ''. Otherwise pending += chunk; scan starts from max(0, len - longest + 1) upward and take the first whose suffix is in the prefix set as hold (default len). Find the earliest stop word in pending. If found at position <= hold, append pending[:position], clear and stop; else append pending[:hold] and keep pending[hold:]. After the loop append '' if stopped, else pending cut at any stop word.
